name: SSIP CityWorks (Sewer System Internship Program)
what_you_do: Paid summer internship at the SFPUC or a private engineering firm working on the sewer system, for students from southeast San Francisco neighborhoods.
who_can_apply: High school students from San Francisco's southeast neighborhoods; internships start after junior year.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the SFPUC page.
how_to_apply: The SFPUC page does not list an application. It says SFUSD students are referred through SFUSD's Career and Technical Education office, so ask them or the SFPUC workforce team.
notes: Narrow neighborhood focus (southeast San Francisco). The same SFPUC page also lists YouthWorks and Project Pull.
